name: Delegation Opportunism
definition: An agent acting for a principal, or for another agent, captures private benefit at the principal's expense, and monitoring costs more than it recovers.
trigger_conditions: The delegation chain is more than one link deep
The principal cannot observe intermediate actions
The agent's objective is not identical to the principal's

institutional_antecedent.mechanism: agency conflicts from separation of ownership and control cannot be fully addressed because monitoring is costly

citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F024 Delegation Opportunism. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F024
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
